parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the Thing Specification Language model version.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter has a value, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModelVersion
parameters.description:
The version number of the Thing Specification Language model.
The version number can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and periods (.). The version number can be up to 16 characters in length.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation to obtain the ProductKey.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

><notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The **ResourceGroupId** request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
></notice>
